## Practice RTMB

- Start with 1 stock and see if you can forecast
- Include age as part of the model
- One option is to have a different Ricker curve for each age class
- Add covariates
- Run a retrospective analysis over the last 12 years of data

## Load in Data

- Example Stellako

```{r}
#| echo: true

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(RTMB)

sox <- read.csv("../data/sockeye/SRDATA2026 1.csv")
stock <- read.csv("../data/sockeye/FC_StockInfo 2.csv")
covariates <- read.csv("../data/sockeye/FC_Environmental_Data_2026_Std_Offset_Real.csv")
sox <- sox %>% left_join(stock, by = "PopID")
sox <- sox %>% left_join(covariates, by = "yr")
sox <- sox %>% filter(!is.na(spawners), !is.na(recruits))
sox <- sox %>% group_by(PopName) %>% mutate(sd_spawners = sd(spawners),  spawners_scaled = spawners/sd_spawners) %>% ungroup()
```

## Age Based Ricker Model

- Carrying capacity is shared between age classes but productivity is not.
- The observations are related so will choose,

$$
  \log(R_{at}/S_t) = N(\boldsymbol{\alpha}_a - \beta S_t, \Sigma)
$$
- Given that we have age 4 returns with `NA` for age 5, we can write this as a conditional normal, for $y_{at} = \log(R_{at}/S_t)$,

\begin{align}
  y_{4t} & \sim N(\mu_{4t}, \sigma_1)\\
  y_{5t} | y_{4t} & \sim  N(\mu_{5t} + \Sigma_{12}/\Sigma_{11}(y_{4t} - m_{4t}), \Sigma_{22} - \Sigma_{12}^2\Sigma_{11})
\end{align}

## Fitting it in RTMB

```{r}
#| echo: true

negll <- function(pars, data){
  getAll(pars, data, warn = FALSE)

  phi <- -1 + 2*plogis(logitphi)
  sigma <- exp(logsigma)
  beta <- exp(logbeta)
  mu4 <- alpha[1] - beta*spawners
  mu5 <- alpha[2] - beta*spawners + phi*sigma[2]/sigma[1]*(logRS4 - mu4)
  mis4 <- is.na(logRS4)
  mis5 <- is.na(logRS5)
  sigma5 <- sqrt(sigma[2]^2*(1-phi^2))

  ll <- sum(dnorm(logRS4[!mis4], mu4[!mis4], sigma[1], log = TRUE))
  ll <- ll + sum(dnorm(logRS5[!mis5], mu5[!mis5], sigma5, log = TRUE))

  ## Prediction is last year of 4 plus previous year of 5.
  n <- length(mu4)
  Eage4 <- exp(mu4)*spawners
  Eage5 <- exp(mu5)*spawners
  pred <- Eage4[n] + Eage5[n-1]
  REPORT(pred)
  REPORT(Eage4)
  REPORT(Eage5)
  return(-ll)
}

```

## Prediction

- Prediction: Combine age 4 prediction with spawners 4 years ago with age 5 expected from the previous spawner group.

```{r}
#| echo: true

sox_ch <- sox %>% filter(PopName == "Stellako") %>%
  mutate(logRS4 = log((age4+1e-4)/spawners),
    logRS5 = log((age5+1e-4)/spawners))

cmb <- function(f, d) function(p) f(p, d)

params <- list(
  logsigma = c(0,0),
  alpha = c(0,0),
  logbeta = 0,
  logitphi = 0
  )

obj <- MakeADFun(cmb(negll, sox_ch), params, silent = TRUE)
fit <- nlminb(obj$par, obj$fn, obj$gr)
pars <- obj$env$parList(fit$par)
```

## Do Prediction

```{r}
#| echo: true

years <- 2000:2021
pred <- NULL
for( i in seq_along(years) ){
  dat <- sox_ch %>% filter(yr <= years[i])
  dat$logRS4[dat$yr == years[i]] <- NA
  dat$logRS5[dat$yr == years[i]] <- NA
  dat$logRS5[dat$yr == years[i]-1] <- NA

  obj <- MakeADFun(cmb(negll, dat), params, silent = TRUE)
  fit <- nlminb(obj$par, obj$fn, obj$gr)
  pars <- obj$env$parList(fit$par)
  pred <- c(pred, obj$report()$pred)
}

pred <- data.frame(year = years+4, pred = pred)

library(tidyr)
recruits_ch <- sox_ch %>% 
  pivot_longer(c(age4, age5)) %>% 
  mutate(year = ifelse(name == "age4", yr + 4, yr + 5)) %>%
  group_by(year) %>% summarize(recruits = sum(value))

recruits_ch %>% ggplot(aes(x = year, y = recruits)) + geom_line() + theme_minimal() +
  geom_line(data = pred, aes(x = year, y = pred), col = 'red')

```

## Adding Covariates

```{r}
#| echo: true

negll <- function(pars, data, X){
  getAll(pars, data, warn = FALSE)

  phi <- -1 + 2*plogis(logitphi)
  sigma <- exp(logsigma)
  beta <- exp(logbeta)
  delta_alpha <- drop(X %*% a)
  
  mu4 <- delta_alpha + alpha[1] - beta*spawners
  mu5 <- delta_alpha + alpha[2] - beta*spawners + phi*sigma[2]/sigma[1]*(logRS4 - mu4)
  mis4 <- is.na(logRS4)
  mis5 <- is.na(logRS5)
  sigma5 <- sqrt(sigma[2]^2*(1-phi^2))

  ll <- sum(dnorm(logRS4[!mis4], mu4[!mis4], sigma[1], log = TRUE))
  ll <- ll + sum(dnorm(logRS5[!mis5], mu5[!mis5], sigma5, log = TRUE))

  ## Prediction is last year of 4 plus previous year of 5.
  n <- length(mu4)
  Eage4 <- exp(mu4)*spawners
  Eage5 <- exp(mu5)*spawners
  pred <- Eage4[n] + Eage5[n-1]
  REPORT(pred)
  REPORT(Eage4)
  REPORT(Eage5)
  return(-ll)
}
cmb <- function(f, d, X) function(p) f(p, d, X)

X <- model.matrix(~peak + aflow + mapsst + pdo + stn2js, data = sox_ch)

params <- list(
  logsigma = c(0,0),
  alpha = c(0,0),
  a = rnorm(ncol(X)),
  logbeta = 0,
  logitphi = 0
  )

obj <- MakeADFun(cmb(negll, sox_ch, X), params, silent = TRUE)
fit <- nlminb(obj$par, obj$fn, obj$gr)
```

## Forecast w/ Covariates

```{r}
sox_ch <- sox %>% filter(PopName == "Stellako") %>%
  mutate(logRS4 = log((age4+1e-4)/spawners),
    logRS5 = log((age5+1e-4)/spawners))

years <- 2000:2021
pred <- NULL
for( i in seq_along(years) ){
  dat <- sox_ch %>% filter(yr <= years[i])
  dat$logRS4[dat$yr == years[i]] <- NA
  dat$logRS5[dat$yr == years[i]] <- NA
  dat$logRS5[dat$yr == years[i]-1] <- NA
  X <- model.matrix(~ peak + aflow + jnesst + pdo + stn2js, data = dat)

  obj <- MakeADFun(cmb(negll, dat, X), params, silent = TRUE)
  fit <- nlminb(obj$par, obj$fn, obj$gr)
  pars <- obj$env$parList(fit$par)
  pred <- c(pred, obj$report()$pred)
}

pred <- data.frame(year = years+4, pred = pred)

recruits_ch <- sox_ch %>% 
  pivot_longer(c(age4, age5)) %>% 
  mutate(year = ifelse(name == "age4", yr + 4, yr + 5)) %>%
  group_by(year) %>% summarize(recruits = sum(value))

recruits_ch %>% ggplot(aes(x = year, y = recruits)) + geom_line() + theme_minimal() +
  geom_line(data = pred, aes(x = year, y = pred), col = 'red')
```
